name: 2442-prefixburst-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, an ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct used for WEIGHTS ONLY, under the Llama 3.1 Community License; byte-identical config.json, ~15 GB in bf16 over four safetensors shards.
parallelism: tp1 on one card. EP=1, PP=1, no router, no external cache tier, no disaggregation.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, bf16, dense. 32 layers, 32 query over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128 (128 KiB of bf16 KV per token), hidden 4096, vocab 128256, 131072 advertised positions.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=140, bounded at 4096 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, seed 42, first 20% of the run discarded as warmup.
workload: configs/data/prefixburst-4096.jsonl, a shipped dataset: 4096 rows in 512 bursts of 8, every row exactly 1087 prompt tokens of which the opening 1024 are shared with its burst and at most 2 with any other row, output pinned at exactly 128 tokens per row via `output_tokens_count` (max_tokens plus ignore_eos), temperature 0.0, raw text to /v1/completions, one pass over the file.
purpose: An 8B assistant answering groups of questions about one shared long document with short replies, 140 concurrent streams, one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is not read, and the engine then starts
# without it, at rc=0.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
max-running-requests: 32
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
max-total-tokens: 131072
context-length: 4096
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
